messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api queue growth detected in us-east-1. p95 latency > 3s, p99 > 12s, active queued requests increasing for last 6m. autoscaler failing to provision GPUs: 'provisioner rate limit' and 'clusterResizeLimitExceeded' errors. tagging oncall. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-queue-spike

alice (oncall): seeing same. console: hosted-us-east queue depth 18k -> backlog. customers hitting 504s. digging into provisioner logs now.

bob (sre): logs from provisioner: 
```
2026-03-15T02:01:12Z ERROR provisioner/provision: api error quotaExceeded: Request has reached allocation quota
2026-03-15T02:01:17Z WARN autoscaler/leader: leader election flapping: timeout=5s
```
Looks like cloud quota hit + leader instability.

carla (runtime): routing fallback is ready. Can enable model-fallback-policy to route traffic to quantized-xsmall variants to reduce GPU need by ~3x. If we flip it we should see token throughput relief quickly.

dan (infra): confirmed provider returned 429 on instance create. Opened support case, request ID: CASE-958712. Requesting temporary quota bump. ETA from provider unclear. Manual pool scale won't succeed while quota 429s persist, but we can shift traffic to Dedicated pools if we preempt less-critical workloads.

erin (support): We already have 2 high priority customer tickets reporting timeouts (acct-847, acct-299). Notifying them of mitigation steps. Can we reduce rate for non-enterprise tiers to buy headroom?

alice (oncall): action list: 1) enable model-fallback-policy now (carla) 2) enable tenant-rate-limiter for free tiers - set to 10 rps (bob) 3) gracefully degrade non-SLA routes -> redirect to edge-cache (frank) 4) escalate cloud quota (dan). I'll coordinate.

carla (runtime): flipping fallback now. Command: 
```
redwoodctl config set hosted-us-east fallback_model=quant-xsmall --apply
```
Applying... done. Observability: queue depth dropping from 18k -> 9.2k in 45s. p95 trending down. :thumbsup:

bob (sre): applying tenant rate-limiter for tiers: 
```
redwoodctl ratelimit update --scope=free --rps=10 --window=60s
```
Done. Per-tenant request lift reduced by ~28%. Backlog now 6.8k. p99 still high (~9s) but hopefully stabilizing.

frank (product): activating aggressive cache TTL for common prompt templates, routed ~12% of traffic to cache. Expect some quality impacts but reduces GPU tokens. Communicating to CS.

dan (infra): gcp-support-bot: CASE-958712 status?
gcp-support-bot: CASE-958712 update: quota increase in review. Estimated resolution 1-2h. If urgent, submit business-critical escalation.

alice (oncall): this is going to be a longer incident. Paging pagerduty for backup oncall. @bob please prepare runbook steps for a controlled canary rollback if fallback causes quality regression.

bob (sre): making a canary route: 10% live -> quant-xsmall for subset of traffic, 90% stays on main. Will monitor metrics.

carla (runtime): canary in place. metrics: canary p95 ~2.1s vs main 6.5s. Errors on canary slightly higher for some regen prompts. Rolling canary to 40% to accelerate relief.

erin (support): updated customers: we are routing to lower-cost variants and applying temporary rate limits to reduce timeouts. Estimated full mitigation in ~1h. Apologized, gave link to status page.

dan (infra): provider offering ephemeral preemptible quota for short term. Initiating preemptible pool spinup while case is pending. Command: 
```
rtu-provisioner create-pool --region=us-east --type=preemptible --gpus=8 --label=emergency-spill
```
Pool creation in progress. If this succeeds we can drain backlog faster but risk preemptions.

alice (oncall): good. Monitor spike behaviour after preemptible pool join. Also set internal alert: if queue depth < 1k for 10m, declare partial mitigation.

bob (sre): preemptible pool joined in ~3m, pods scheduled. Observed drop: backlog 6.8k -> 2.1k over 12m. p99 down to 2.9s. Customers reporting fewer 504s.

frank (product): note: this spike was linked to a partner campaign redirecting many short prompt calls. Need GA throttling rules for partner integrations. Add to postmortem.

alice (oncall): handoff note at 03:15Z: queue depth 2.1k, p95 1.2s, p99 3.0s. provider case still open. Preemptible pool keeping us stable. Oncall handing to night-shift (bob) for monitoring and cloud escalation. I'll update incident timeline.

bob (sre): acknowledged. I'll keep watch and runbook the postmortem items into a GH issue.

erin (support): customers notified of update. No major SLA breaches reported yet, keeping them informed.

carla (runtime): follow-ups: 1) make quant-xsmall fallback automatic for extreme queue growth, 2) add autoscaler retry/backoff improvements, 3) expose per-tenant throttle controls in console.

dan (infra): follow-ups: 1) pre-authorize emergency quota increases with provider, 2) refine leader election timeouts to avoid flapping under load.

alice (oncall): closing active paging loop. Will open postmortem draft and assign owners. Thanks everyone. :heart:
